launch.label: Launch
launch.basis: NASA and SpaceX are targeting liftoff no earlier than 7:26 am EDT on Sunday 30 August 2026, on a Falcon Heavy from Launch Complex 39A at Kennedy Space Center. That is nine months ahead of the old schedule: the commitment used to be no later than May 2027. A launch time can still slip, so this clock counts to the target, not to a promise.
launch.source_label: NASA, Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope mission page

no_js: Roman is targeting launch on 30 August 2026 at 7:26 am EDT.
